repo_grounded_facts.statement: SCS curve-number runoff: Q = (P - Ia)^2 / (P - Ia + S) when P > Ia, else Q = 0; S = 1000/CN - 10 (inches); Ia = 0.2 * S; valid CN in (0, 100]. 1 in/hr of runoff over 1 sq mi = 645.33 cfs. Event-based and empirical; no snowmelt, no antecedent-moisture adjustment, no channel routing.
Diffusion-wave face flux (Manning): q = sign(S) * (1/n) * hFlow^(5/3) * sqrt(|S|); face diffusivity D = h_flow^(5/3) / (n * sqrt(|S|)); manningN must be a finite number > 0.
Explicit diffusive stability criterion: dtSec <= dx^2 / (4 * D_max); the module throws fail-closed if violated. SLOPE_FLOOR = 1e-12: |S| below it is treated as zero flux (unconditionally stable).

Hazus depth-damage engine: occupancy types RES-1SNB, RES-2SNB, COM, IND; tables span 0-10 ft and depths beyond 10 ft clamp to the 10-ft values (a fail-safe, not an extrapolation). Hazus-compatible, NOT FEMA-certified; this is NOT FEMA HAZUS software. Never use outputs as evidence of eligibility, benefits, or losses without human expert review.
